units.source_text: 相形之下，千重子则感到心烦意乱，双腿发颤，仿佛要使劲踏住才站得稳似的。

en.t: By contrast, Chieko felt agitated and confused, her legs trembling as if she had to plant them firmly just to keep standing.

units.source_text: 在这种场合，她是很难马上平静下来的。

en.t: In such a situation, it was very hard for her to calm down at once.

units.source_text: 似乎只有这个姑娘健康的美在支撑着她。

en.t: It seemed that only the healthy beauty of this girl was sustaining her.

units.source_text: 千重子岂止没有像姑娘那样流露出淳朴的喜悦，眼睛里还深含着忧伤的神色。

en.t: Chieko not only failed to show the same simple joy as the girl, but her eyes also held a deep look of sorrow.
